question: What payment gateways are natively supported by the directory software?
ground_truth_context: Brilliant Directories natively supports Stripe and PayPal for payment gateway processing.

question: Where do I configure my custom domain name in the admin dashboard?
ground_truth_context: Domain configuration is located under Settings > Domain Settings in the admin panel.

question: What is the default currency configuration for new directories?
ground_truth_context: The default currency is USD, configurable in General Settings.

question: Can directory administrators moderate user reviews before they are published?
ground_truth_context: Yes, administrators can enable review moderation in Member Settings > Reviews.

question: What image file formats are accepted for directory logos?
ground_truth_context: Standard formats PNG, JPG, and WEBP with a recommended width of 500px.

question: How do I set up Stripe payment processing step by step?
ground_truth_context: Step 1: Obtain Stripe API keys. Step 2: Navigate to Settings > Payment Gateways. Step 3: Paste publishable and secret keys. Step 4: Click Save Changes and run a test charge.

question: What are the steps to add a new top-level member category?
ground_truth_context: Navigate to My Members > Member Categories > Add Top Category. Enter name and slug, then save.

question: How do I export members data to a CSV file?
ground_truth_context: Go to My Members > Search Members. Select filtered members or all, then click the Export CSV button at the top right.

question: How do I configure SMTP custom email provider?
ground_truth_context: Go to Settings > Email Settings. Select Custom SMTP, enter Host, Port (587/465), Username, Password, and TLS setting, then send a test email.

question: How can I bulk import member listings from an external spreadsheet?
ground_truth_context: Go to My Members > Import Members. Download the template CSV, map columns, upload, and run import.

question: What are all the requirements to launch a paid membership tier?
ground_truth_context: Requires configuring a payment gateway (Stripe/PayPal), setting up a membership plan with pricing, and defining feature permissions for that tier.

question: How do member reviews impact search ranking and profile visibility?
ground_truth_context: Reviews appear on public profiles, affect the star rating badge, and can be used as a sorting filter in member search results.

question: How do custom categories tie into SEO meta tags and URL structure?
ground_truth_context: Category slugs become part of the directory URL path and automatically populate default SEO title and meta descriptions if configured in SEO templates.

question: How can I restrict lead inquiries so only premium tier members receive them?
ground_truth_context: In Lead Settings, set lead matching rules to filter by membership tier ID and grant the receive leads privilege only to selected plans.

question: What is the complete workflow when a member account expires due to billing failure?
ground_truth_context: Automated webhook notification is received, status changes to Past Due, dunning emails are triggered, and after grace period profile is hidden from search.

question: What is the exact refund policy for account cancellations after 60 days?
ground_truth_context: Documentation does not state a 60-day refund policy and requires billing department review.
